Rentokil Boecker®'s Area Sales Manager is held accountable for the below job responsibilities: ▪ Sales Management Achieving the Sales target of his/her unit (Sales, Earned Revenue & Profitability) Executing the Business Development Manager's (BDM) strategy through SMART action plans Validating the offering & pricing of his/her team to ensure profitability Consistently meeting the Key Performance Indicators set by the BDM Opening and developing sales channels for his/her team Providing recommendations on tactical marketing activities within their area Practicing social selling by leveraging his/her social network to reach prospects Establishing an effective lead management & follow-up process ▪ Team Management Developing his/her sales team through effective people management Delivering On the job training and supporting during field visits with the team Assessing strengths and areas for improvement against a set of KPIs Selling on his/her team behalf when necessary Evaluating individual performances and taking early actions ▪ Accounts Management Developing sales programs that maximize sales from the assigned accounts Crafting sales programs to his/her team which includes offers, bundles, solutions, etc. Establishing & maintaining strong client relationships with decision makers Ensuring client satisfaction through follow-up with the relevant internal stakeholders Promoting up-selling & cross-selling within the existing customer base ▪ Data Management & Reporting Account profitability report for existing clients Industry analysis & recent market trends Market research & competitive analysis SWOT analysis of the zone Requirements ▪ Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration or equivalent. ▪ At least 8 years of experience in Marketing, Sales or Business Development. ▪ Excellent sales and negotiation skills. ▪ Effective decision making and problem-solving skills. ▪ Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Benefits ▪ Competitive Salary ▪ 22 vacation days per year ▪ 1 yearly ticket to visit home country ▪ Medical Insurance Class A

jobs.title: Sales Manager (Compressor/Turbine)
jobs.description: Position Summary: This position is responsible for directing the sales and distribution of gas compression and power generation equipment, including natural gas compressors, gas turbine generator packages, process gas compressor packages, gas treatment solutions, and related equipment to customers in the oil & gas, power, and industrial sectors. The position is focused on achieving sales objectives by developing market penetration plans, formulating sales strategies, and driving order closure. Analyze market information, competitors, and sales statistics to identify business opportunities and customer demand, while monitoring customer preferences and market trends to support sustainable business growth. Job Responsibilities: Responsible for exploring and developing business opportunities, building strong relationships with appropriate client contacts and executing strategic and tactical business plans. Following-up the market dynamics in the industry. Conducts sales activities such as volume and margin analysis, supporting tender activity, resolving customer operational issues and monitoring pricing performance integrity to enhance customer perception of value. Maintain and promote relationships with customer contacts who may be determining potential opportunities and deal with existing business challenges Develop market research, main competitor analysis report to support management decision-making. Accomplished the detached duty and supported supervisor. Adheres to all company policies, procedures and business ethics codes and ensures that they are communicated and implemented within the team. Job Requirements: At least 2 years sales experience in oil & gas industry. Familiar with Saudi Arabia's oil and gas industry, relevant experience is preferred Experience of Oil & Gas industry-related standards, regulations, market operation and business type in Saudi Arabia. Strong connections with National Oil Companies and Oil Service Companies in Saudi Arabia. Work Location: Dammam, Saudi Arabia

jobs.title: Sales Manager (Saudi National Only)
jobs.description: Company Description The FAENA Movement is a journey of art, culture, and community. Rooted in the soulful traditions of the South and elevated by imaginative design, our culture celebrates authentic hospitality and transformative experiences. We create spaces where dreams are brought to life—through bold ideas, meaningful collaboration, and a deep sense of purpose. As we continue our expansion into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Faena The Red Sea will mark a new chapter—visionary in spirit, exceptional in execution. We’re building more than a hotel; we’re shaping a world of beauty, wonder, and connection. If you’re driven by creativity, excellence, and a desire to be part of something extraordinary, we invite you to help bring this vision to life. Job Description The Sales Manager at Faena The Red Sea plays a key role in driving revenue growth and establishing the property’s presence within the global luxury travel market during the preopening and launch phase. This position is responsible for proactively generating transient, corporate, and group business within assigned territories and market segments, while building strategic relationships that position Faena The Red Sea as one of the region’s most sought-after ultra-luxury destinations. As a brand ambassador, the Sales Manager represents Faena’s distinctive blend of culture, lifestyle, wellness, and hospitality, ensuring the hotel is strongly positioned among luxury travel advisors, entertainment networks, corporate accounts, and high-value clientele. This role works closely with Revenue Management, Reservations, and Operations to convert opportunities, maximize market share, and deliver a seamless guest journey from enquiry to arrival. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute targeted sales action plans for assigned territories, market segments, and accounts. Proactively solicit and generate new business opportunities across transient, leisure, corporate, entertainment, and group segments. Build and maintain strong relationships with luxury travel advisors, preferred agencies, corporate travel buyers, family offices, concierge networks, and lifestyle partners. Represent Faena The Red Sea at international trade shows, roadshows, sales missions, networking events, and client activations. Conduct regular sales calls, presentations, and site inspections to secure new business and strengthen partnerships. Achieve or exceed individual monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals. Work closely with Revenue Management to understand market demand, pricing strategy, and pace reports to identify opportunities. C
